register_param_scheduler: register a custom ClassyParamScheduler subclass using the register_param_scheduler decorator with a unique name
create_ClassyParamScheduler: create a ClassyParamScheduler subclass that implements __call__ and from_config to schedule optimizer parameters
test_param_scheduler_epoch: test a param scheduler with UpdateInterval.EPOCH to verify it updates learning rate each epoch
test_param_scheduler_step: test a param scheduler with UpdateInterval.STEP to verify it updates learning rate each training step
test_UpdateInterval_from_config: test UpdateInterval.from_config to parse update interval strings like epoch or step from a config dict
